verification.method: Flow Music iOS app screenshots supplied by Sean, 2026-09-16; press for launch dates (Flow Music 2026-04-18, Lyria 3.5 2026-07-29).
verified: Compose sheet field set and order: Lyrics, Instrumental toggle, Sound, Model, Seed, BPM, Length, Title, Cover image
Instrumental toggle changes the Lyrics placeholder to 'Instrumental'
Model selector options: Lyria 3.5 (flagship), Lyria 3 Pro (legacy)
Settings selectors: Instrument (music model), Ghostwriter (Standard/Pro), Producer (Standard/Fast)
Producer chat accepts numbered multi-step commands including a time-range trim ('Trim the song from 40s to 48s')
Producer chat has an attachment control (+) and suggestion chips (spaces, remix)
Sessions are named and persisted; navigation: Explore, Songs, Playlists, Music Videos, Spaces, Search, Profile
unverified: character limits on Sound and Lyrics (no counters visible)
whether Lyrics accepts section tags when Instrumental is ON, or is disabled
Length units and maximum (press: 30 s to 3 min)
whether BPM is a hard lock or guidance
Producer command grammar for section-level edits (section painting)
artist-name filtering behaviour and any banned-term list
whether Cover image is decorative only or also a creative reference

fields.label: Lyrics
fields.notes: User-supplied lyrics pass through untouched. For instrumentals, structure tags may go here if verification shows they are read; until then the Producer script carries structure.

fields.label: Sound
fields.notes: Style-equivalent. Same priority order as Suno Style: form/meter/tempo, key/mode, drum grammar, regional instruments, synth roles, textures, transitions, bridge/finale, mood, inline negatives last. No Exclude field exists, so negatives are inline and reported as 'approximated'.

fields.label: BPM
fields.notes: Numeric field, 'auto' when empty. Written from Form.tempo. Lock strength unverified; tempo is also restated in Sound.

fields.label: Length
fields.notes: 'Auto' or a duration. Written from the runtime target computed by bar math.

fields.label: Seed
fields.notes: Reproducibility handle. Empty on first render; stored on every Take; printed when reproducing a kept take.

fields.label: Cover image
fields.notes: Optional. Not serialized; EVAWAVE never uploads reference images on the user's behalf.

fields.label: Producer chat
fields.notes: Not a form field: numbered instructions pasted into 'Ask Producer...'. First render: one instruction per section for structure and dynamics. Later Variants: the diff against the parent compiled to revision ops, with bar ranges converted to time ranges via bar math.

toggles.label: Instrumental
toggles.effect: Suppresses vocals; Lyrics placeholder becomes 'Instrumental'. Interaction with structure tags unverified.

driftWordsNote: Inherited from the Suno v6 list; not yet tested against Lyria 3.5. Take-log 'wordsBlamed' entries for this engine feed the review queue.
bannedTermsNote: Unverified. The lineage pass strips artist and producer names before serialization regardless.
aliasesNote: Inherited from the Suno profile; re-verify per engine.

supportsNotes.D3: Per-section dynamics only via Producer script.
supportsNotes.D6: Tempo native via BPM field; key, mode and meter as prose in Sound; no meter lock.
supportsNotes.D7: Structure tags in Lyrics unverified; Producer script carries structure and revisions.
supportsNotes.D10: No Exclude field (negatives inline); length, seed and title native.

postRender: Section painting: highlight a section in the render and revise it in place.
Producer chat edit ops: trim, extend, replace a section, restyle, remix.
Download from Songs; SynthID watermark on every output.
For DAW handoff use the word-MIDI blueprint; Flow does not export stems (unverified).
notes: Flow accepts uploaded or recorded audio and images as references through the Producer chat; EVAWAVE does not upload on the user's behalf.
Producer script is EVAWAVE's unique channel here: Variant diffs become revision commands, and bar math converts bar ranges to the time ranges Flow's trim command expects.
Credits vary by selector choice (Fast/Standard, Standard/Pro); EVAWAVE records the selector values on each Take.
